fact_text: On 11 March 2026 oil fell back after a peak near $120 a barrel, with WTI and North Sea Brent trading around $83 to $87 a barrel.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 11 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Drop After $120 Peak | Impact on OGDCL, POL, Mari, PPL' (YouTube, 2026-03-11)

fact_text: The analyst's sensitivity estimate was that every $10 rise in crude would add about Rs4 to OGDCL's earnings per share, because it has a meaningful oil content.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 11 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Drop After $120 Peak | Impact on OGDCL, POL, Mari, PPL' (YouTube, 2026-03-11)

fact_text: Pakistan Petroleum has a low oil content of about 10 percent of its output, so the analyst estimated that a $10 rise in crude would add only about Rs2 to its earnings per share.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 11 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Drop After $120 Peak | Impact on OGDCL, POL, Mari, PPL' (YouTube, 2026-03-11)

fact_text: Pakistan Oilfields has a small paid-up capital, so a $10 rise in crude would have a large per-share earnings effect, although its production is small.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 11 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Drop After $120 Peak | Impact on OGDCL, POL, Mari, PPL' (YouTube, 2026-03-11)

fact_text: Mari is primarily a gas company, so the analyst expected a $10 rise in crude to have only a minimal effect on its earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 11 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Drop After $120 Peak | Impact on OGDCL, POL, Mari, PPL' (YouTube, 2026-03-11)

fact_text: Bagjai-Nashpa test numbers in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa were described as very strong, with about 14,000 to 15,000 barrels a day reported on PSX after five drill stem tests.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 11 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Drop After $120 Peak | Impact on OGDCL, POL, Mari, PPL' (YouTube, 2026-03-11)

fact_text: South African Richards Bay coal, which is imported through the PIBTL terminal, is closely correlated with oil, and its price rose sharply in early 2026, which is a negative for cement makers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 11 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Drop After $120 Peak | Impact on OGDCL, POL, Mari, PPL' (YouTube, 2026-03-11)

fact_text: Cement makers had been mixing local, imported and Richards Bay coal, but high-grade coal users depend on Richards Bay coal, so the analyst said the price rise hurts them most.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 11 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Drop After $120 Peak | Impact on OGDCL, POL, Mari, PPL' (YouTube, 2026-03-11)

fact_text: The government absorbed the fuel price rise through the ex-refinery price, raising petrol from Rs267 to Rs322 a litre and diesel to Rs332 a litre, rather than through tax.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 11 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Drop After $120 Peak | Impact on OGDCL, POL, Mari, PPL' (YouTube, 2026-03-11)

fact_text: The analyst said oil marketing companies were expected to book inventory gains of about Rs113 billion, which would move them into profit, mainly benefiting the largest marketer by market share.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash | 11 MAR 2026 |  Oil Prices Drop After $120 Peak | Impact on OGDCL, POL, Mari, PPL' (YouTube, 2026-03-11)

fact_text: Attock Petroleum has low storage, so its inventory gains and losses from oil price swings are smaller, and its share price fell less than others during the market downturn.

fact_text: The 5G spectrum auction in Pakistan was under way in March 2026, and the analyst expected it to lift the IT, freelancing and social media sectors.
